entities.summary: "Call on Me" is a song by the Swedish DJ and producer Eric Prydz. It is based on a sample of the 1982 Steve Winwood song "Valerie", and was inspired by a similar track created by the French duo Together. Its music video features women performing aerobics and dancing suggestively.
